messages:
maria (docs): FYI the Playground preview quickstart is failing for new accounts — iframe shows blank and network returns 500 on /telemetry/events.
kevin (console): thanks, can you paste repro steps and any gateway error logs?
maria (docs): Steps: Playground -> select model -> Run. Gateway logs show "missing telemetry key" and stack traces pointing at telemetry auth.
jenna (qa): root cause: infra rotated the telemetry key. docs sample still had a hardcoded TELEMETRY_KEY in the JS snippet. Quick fix is to use an env var and send x-redwood-telemetry header.
sam (devex): let's add a tiny headless smoke test in CI for the snippet so we catch regressions. I can wire the job; tag the PR with pr:run-preview.
maria (docs): opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3876 . Replaced hardcoded key with process.env.REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY and added a troubleshooting section.
kevin (console): also add a short note in console/preview.md that private/air-gapped deployments must configure the gateway proxy and X-Redwood-Telemetry header.
maria (docs): added that note and a "Troubleshooting preview failures" box with sample logs and fix steps.
jenna (qa): added examples/playground/test_preview.py which hits /preview-session and asserts 200. Local run: `pytest examples/playground/test_preview.py::test_preview_headless` passes. Adding to CI matrix. :white_check_mark:
sam (devex): can we include a minimal Python server-side telemetry example too? 3 lines.
maria (docs): added under examples/server/telemetry.py: `import os, requests
key = os.getenv('REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_KEY','')
requests.post('https://proxy.redwood.ai/telemetry/events', headers={'x-redwood-telemetry': key}, json={'event':'run'})`
kevin (console): LGTM. @deploy-bot run preview smoke for PR 3876.
deploy-bot: queued preview infra smoke job for PR 3876. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/3876/preview-log
maria (docs): will merge after CI is green and open a backport to v1.2. thanks for the quick turnaround everyone! :rocket:
